name: Datto Backupify
description_en:
Backupify provides cloud-to-cloud backup for Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace. It protects supported SaaS data and offers search, export and granular restoration. This is different from backing up a user’s local computer or rebuilding its operating system.

The Microsoft 365 product page covers Exchange Online, OneDrive for Business, SharePoint Online and Teams; the Google offering has its own scope. This profile examines a tenant-level recovery workflow rather than borrowing every feature from the wider Datto family.
description_zh:
Backupify 为 Microsoft 365 和 Google Workspace 提供云到云备份，可搜索、导出和细粒度恢复受支持 SaaS 数据，与备份用户本地电脑或重建操作系统不同。

Microsoft 365 产品页涵盖 Exchange Online、OneDrive for Business、SharePoint Online 和 Teams；Google 产品另有范围。本文分析租户层面恢复流程，不把 Datto 整个产品家族功能搬入。

sections.title_en: From protected users to a restored item
sections.title_zh: 从受保护用户到恢复单项
sections.en:
The official Microsoft 365 page describes three automatic backups daily, on-demand runs and configurable retention. Administrators can search and restore individual items, choose the original or another user, or download data. It describes non-overwriting recovery, but exact object-specific duplicate and permission behavior still needs a test.

For a pilot, connect an authorized test tenant, confirm the intended users and workloads are protected, complete a backup, then recover a disposable deleted message and an earlier document version. Verify folder context, content and permissions in the destination. A configured tenant is not proof that each object was captured.
sections.zh:
官方 Microsoft 365 页说明每日三次自动备份、按需执行及可配置保留期。管理员可搜索恢复单项、选择原用户或其他用户，也可下载；其说明恢复不覆盖现有数据，但准确到对象的重复和权限行为仍需测试。

试点可连接授权测试租户，确认目标用户及工作负载已受保护，完成备份后恢复一封可丢弃已删邮件和一个旧文档版本，并在目标核对目录、内容及权限。租户已配置不能证明每个对象均已捕获。

sections.title_en: Read retention and security as conditions
sections.title_zh: 把保留和安全说明连同条件阅读
sections.en:
The homepage describes Datto private-cloud storage, encryption and flexible retention with an infinite default that can be customized. This is a vendor description, not a contractual promise for every order or an independent audit. The Microsoft 365 page also discusses inactive-user archiving and administrator monitoring.

Define retention and offboarding before deleting a production account. Check the actual archived user can still be searched and restored, and ask how protected-seat charges change. A backup schedule does not establish zero data loss between captures, and product security language does not certify a customer’s compliance.
sections.zh:
首页说明 Datto 私有云存储、加密及可配置保留，并称默认无限保留。这是厂商描述，不是每个订单的合同承诺或独立审计。Microsoft 365 页还涉及离职用户归档和管理员监控。

删除生产账户前，应先定义保留和离职处理；核对归档用户仍可搜索恢复，并询问受保护席位费用如何变化。备份调度不能证明两次捕获间零数据丢失，产品安全文案也不能认证客户已合规。

sections.title_en: Quote protected users and recovery scope
sections.title_zh: 按受保护用户和恢复范围询价
sections.en:
The pricing page states a per-user monthly/yearly basis and requests a quote; no public numeric amount is supplied. Obtain terms for active and archived users, minimum purchase, retention, storage, support and cancellation. Leave amount fields empty instead of importing a directory’s historical starting rate.

Shortlist Backupify when independent recovery of the supported SaaS objects is the task. It does not establish coverage for all Microsoft services or all Google objects. Required consent scopes, API throttling, retry behavior, supported regions, legal licensing and actual restore speed were not verified, so a representative restore remains necessary before rollout.
sections.zh:
定价页说明按用户按月／年计费并要求询价，没有公开数字金额。需取得活跃与归档用户、最低购买量、保留、存储、支持及取消条款，金额留空，不沿用目录历史起价。

需要独立恢复所支持 SaaS 对象时，可考虑 Backupify，不能据此证明所有 Microsoft 服务或 Google 对象均被覆盖。所需授权范围、API 限流、重试、区域、法律许可和真实恢复速度未确认，上线前仍需代表性恢复。
